card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Overview**

The Director of Operations provides executive leadership across operations and business management, aligning strategic priorities with financial and project oversight. This role guides process improvement and change management to support effective, coordinated business performance.

**Duties**

* Lead day-to-day operations management and business management.
* Provide executive leadership and guide strategic management.
* Oversee financial management and budget planning.
* Direct project management and coordinate priorities.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Lead change management to support organizational transitions.
* Your impact: Strong operational and financial oversight helps teams use resources effectively and advance business priorities.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated capability in operations and business management.
* Sound judgment in executive leadership and strategic planning.
* Knowledge of financial management and budget oversight.
* Ability to organize projects and manage competing priorities.
* Skill in assessing processes and identifying improvements.
* Ability to guide change and communicate priorities clearly.

Pay: $171,700.00 - $240,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Washington, DC 20002
